nodes.label: MemoryRateLimitStore
nodes.rationale: Process-local fixed-window store bounded by maxKeys (default 10,000) that evicts the oldest insertion; multi-process deployments must supply a shared RateLimitStore.

nodes.label: RateLimitGuard
nodes.rationale: Consumes one token per request via RateLimitService, emits RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers on allowed responses, and throws a 429 Problem Details refusal with Retry-After when exhausted.

nodes.label: RateLimitModule
nodes.rationale: ConfigurableModuleBuilder definition providing and exporting RATE_LIMIT_MODULE_OPTIONS, supporting forRoot and forRootAsync (useFactory, useClass, useExisting) while keeping register/registerAsync as deprecated aliases.

nodes.label: getCspNonce
nodes.rationale: Replaces {nonce} in CSP headers with a fresh per-request nonce and exposes the same value for that request only when the policy includes the {nonce} placeholder.

nodes.label: MemorySessionStore
nodes.rationale: Bounded process-local session store (default maxSessions 10,000) with lazy expiry and oldest-insertion eviction; distributed deployments supply a shared SessionStore.

nodes.label: RedisRateLimitStore
nodes.rationale: Derives resetAt from live PTTL instead of Date.now() + windowMs so the RateLimit-Reset header does not slide forward on every hit.

nodes.label: RedisRefreshTokenStore
nodes.rationale: consume() executes as one Lua round trip that reads, deletes, and keeps a family tombstone so token replay revokes the entire token family.

nodes.label: 429 Problem Details Refusal with Retry-After
nodes.rationale: Returns 429 Problem Details and Retry-After in whole seconds when the bucket is exhausted so clients wait for the reset window instead of retrying blindly.

nodes.label: Route Identity Default Bucket Key
nodes.rationale: Default bucket key uses route identity instead of X-Forwarded-For or other client-supplied headers because direct clients can spoof headers; custom key functions are only supplied when behind a trusted proxy.

nodes.label: Neutral Global HttpPolicy Integration
nodes.rationale: Response-header and CSRF policies are neutral HttpPolicy values run globally by the shared platform-core request pipeline; headers apply in the response phase (including missing routes) and CSRF runs before routing.

nodes.label: Timing-Safe CSRF Verification and Redacted Errors
nodes.norm_label: timing-safe csrf verification and redacted errors
nodes.rationale: HMAC-signed CSRF token signatures are compared with timingSafeEqual rather than === to prevent timing side-channels, and refusals return 403 Problem Details without token, cookie, secret, or stack details.

nodes.label: Opt-In Signed Double-Submit CSRF
nodes.rationale: CSRF is opt-in because it is only meaningful for cookie-based sessions; the cookie is intentionally HttpOnly: false so client code can echo the HMAC-signed nonce in x-csrf-token.

nodes.label: HMAC-Signed Id-Only HttpOnly Session Cookie
nodes.rationale: Session cookies store only an HMAC-signed session id verified with timing-safe comparison while data remains in SessionStore; middleware installs cookie writers before the handler so mutations write immediately even on platforms whose middleware chain does not wrap the handler.

nodes.label: Session Fixation Defence via regenerate()
nodes.rationale: regenerate() deletes the old session id before writing the new one so an id issued prior to login or privilege escalation cannot remain valid.

nodes.label: SCAN and UNLINK Cleanup Pattern
nodes.rationale: clear() and family cleanup page with SCAN and delete with UNLINK when available, falling back to KEYS/DEL only for minimal clients so shared Redis instances are never blocked by KEYS.

nodes.label: Idempotent Shared Redis Client Release
nodes.rationale: Every store exposes idempotent close() and Symbol.asyncDispose; releases its client unless closeClient: false, and quits a shared client exactly once on the first close().

nodes.community_name: Nest-ESM Template LLMs Guide & aponia-cli.json C

nodes.label: Own-Only Metadata vs Inherited Constructor Dependencies
nodes.community_name: Nest-ESM Template LLMs Guide & aponia-cli.json C
nodes.norm_label: own-only metadata vs inherited constructor dependencies
nodes.rationale: Module, controller, enhancer, and validation metadata use Reflect.getOwnMetadata so subclasses do not inherit parent metadata, whereas design:paramtypes and @Inject() use Reflect.getMetadata so subclasses without a constructor resolve parent constructor tokens.

nodes.label: RwCell Fail-Fast vs AsyncRwLock Fair Queueing
nodes.community_name: Nest-ESM Template LLMs Guide & aponia-cli.json C
nodes.norm_label: rwcell fail-fast vs asyncrwlock fair queueing
nodes.rationale: RwCell fails fast with BORROW_CONFLICT on ordinary contention, while AsyncRwLock runs readers concurrently, queues writers, holds later readers behind queued writers to prevent writer starvation, and detects nested self-reentrancy immediately via AsyncLocalStorage BorrowContext.

nodes.label: Exempt APP_* Multi-Provider Tokens
nodes.community_name: Nest-ESM Template LLMs Guide & aponia-cli.json C

nodes.label: Eager Module Graph Compilation
nodes.community_name: Nest-ESM Template LLMs Guide & aponia-cli.json C
nodes.rationale: compileModuleGraph validates module identity (instanceId ?? id), import cycles, duplicate tokens, unknown provider shapes, unresolvable exports, and missing dependencies before any instance exists.

nodes.label: Property-Based DI (@Inject and @Optional)
nodes.rationale: Support NestJS property injection on class fields including Scope.REQUEST bubbling, forwardRef, subclass inheritance, and ModuleRef.create() while keeping common <- core one-way dependency and frozen descriptors.

nodes.label: Undeclared Enhancer & Pipe DI Resolution
nodes.rationale: Auto-instantiate undeclared classes passed to @UseGuards, @UseInterceptors, @UsePipes, @UseFilters, @Param, and APP_GUARD using the controller's module DI scope while reusing declared providers when present.

nodes.label: Zero-RxJS CallStream & CallHandler Contract
nodes.rationale: Provide a lightweight CallStream<T> implementing both PromiseLike<T> and .pipe()/.subscribe() with built-in @aponiajs/common operators (tap, map, catchError, timeout, of, throwError, lastValueFrom) to match NestInterceptor DX without requiring rxjs at runtime.

nodes.label: Built-in @Exclude/@Expose/@Transform & ClassSerializerInterceptor

nodes.label: Synchronous TestingModule.createNestApplication() & Deferred init()
nodes.rationale: Create the application synchronously while sharing TestingModule container instances so app.useGlobal* and setGlobalPrefix can be configured before await app.init(), preserving backward compatibility with createAponiaApplication().

nodes.label: NestJS 1:1 Compatibility Posture
nodes.rationale: Achieve 1:1 NestJS DX and API parity via compatible aliases and closing behavioral gaps while preserving Aponia's Bun/Elysia strengths: Standard Schema validation, zero-RxJS runtime, Elysia sucrose static compilation on non-intercept() routes, and descriptor authoring via defineModule/defineController.

nodes.label: Synchronized Workspace Versions

nodes.rationale: Partitions defenses across five boundaries: client-to-application, application-to-dependency, application-to-outbound-service, application-to-operator-surfaces, and process-to-shared-state.

nodes.rationale: Projects exclusively from the platform-neutral boot record and RequestLifecycleHook instead of reading native route tables, enabling parity across Elysia, Hono, H3, and Web Fetch with explicitly documented degradations.

nodes.label: Describe-Only OpenAPI Document & Inlined Schemas

nodes.label: Durable Backlog vs Distributed Broker Boundary
nodes.norm_label: durable backlog vs distributed broker boundary
nodes.rationale: Hydrates stored running jobs as pending and validates transitions via INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, serving one consumer's backlog rather than multi-consumer claiming.

nodes.label: AuthGuard
nodes.rationale: Extracts bearer or cookie token, verifies signature and jti revocation, calls AuthService.enter, and writes user and frozen session onto RouteContext.

nodes.label: AuthModule
nodes.rationale: ConfigurableModuleBuilder definition with one arm where isGlobal and globalGuard default to true; registerAsync is refused because the jwt/oidc arm decides which verifier provider exists.

nodes.label: AuthService
nodes.rationale: Reads RequestContextService rather than private AsyncLocalStorage because the guard runs in a different async context than the route handler.

nodes.label: @CurrentUser and @CurrentSession Decorators
nodes.rationale: Read authenticated user and frozen session from RouteContext and return null on @Public() routes or outside a request.

nodes.label: JwtService
nodes.rationale: Signs and verifies tokens through jose with issuer, audience, and algorithm checks, kid-based key selection, minimum 32-character secret, and automatic jti minting.

nodes.label: OidcService
nodes.rationale: Reads provider discovery document, pins configured issuer, and verifies tokens against cached published key sets.

nodes.label: PasswordHasherService
nodes.rationale: Delegates password hashing and verification to Bun.password instead of hand-rolling a KDF.

nodes.label: PermissionsGuard
nodes.rationale: Authorization guard preserving the distinction between 401 authentication errors and 403 Problem Details authorization errors.

nodes.label: RevocationService
nodes.rationale: Tracks revoked access-token jti claims until expiry in a bounded process-local store or custom shared store.

nodes.norm_label: bearer header and cookie token transport

nodes.rationale: Decorator metadata and async plugin factories are discovered at runtime and omitted from static Eden types unless lowered by aponia build into descriptors.generated.ts, avoiding unsound type casts.

nodes.rationale: Exact peer pinning prevents caret ranges over prereleases from matching experimental Elysia releases like 2.0.0-exp.64 and prevents Bun from installing mismatched workspace copies.

nodes.rationale: Plans no files because @aponiajs/cli owns manifest rewriting and package installation using workspace version resolution; the factory exists so the update alias resolves uniformly.

nodes.label: aponia-cli.json
nodes.rationale: Configuration schematic renders aponia-cli.json with verified Aponia defaults rather than nest-cli.json while preserving the Nest-shaped collection as a compatibility surface.

nodes.label: Plain-Function Schematic Factory Contract
nodes.rationale: Defines factories as (options) => { files } without an @angular-devkit/schematics dependency so publishing or consuming third-party collections requires no Angular DevKit runtime.

nodes.label: Template .tmpl Suffix Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Every template carries a .tmpl suffix and src/lib/**/files/** is excluded from check lanes so <%= ... %> placeholders never reach tsc, Oxlint, or Oxfmt.

nodes.label: Schematics Dist Asset Copy Build
nodes.rationale: Build emits TypeScript into dist/ and copies every schema.json and template file beside it so collection.json relative paths resolve in the published package.

nodes.label: Bounded Responses and Redacted Errors
nodes.rationale: Timeouts cover the entire body read and responses are size-bounded (1 MiB default), while AponiaError details use safeUrl and omit response bodies, query strings, and credentials.

nodes.label: Idempotent and Keyed Retry Policy
nodes.rationale: Only idempotent methods retry by default; POST and PATCH retry solely when an idempotencyKey is supplied so request bodies are never replayed unkeyed, and Retry-After overrides backoff up to 30 seconds.

nodes.label: SSRF Protection Policy
nodes.rationale: Allows only http/https without URL credentials, blocks private/loopback/link-local/metadata/NAT64/IPv4-translated ranges, resolves and checks every DNS address, pins the validated IP with Host and TLS SNI to stop DNS rebinding, and re-validates redirects.

nodes.label: Split forRoot and register Registration Pattern
nodes.norm_label: split forroot and register registration pattern
nodes.rationale: Mirrors @nestjs/http-client by splitting app-wide defaults (forRoot/forRootAsync registering no client) from per-client creation (register/registerAsync under HttpClient or HttpClient:<name>).

nodes.label: @aponiajs/cache
nodes.rationale: Provides bounded process-local TTL caching with oldest-insertion eviction and a pluggable store contract; intentionally not a distributed cache, session store, or durable queue.

nodes.label: @aponiajs/rate-limit
nodes.rationale: Uses route identity rather than client-supplied headers as the default rate-limit key to prevent spoofing unless a trusted proxy key function is supplied.

nodes.label: RefreshTokenService
nodes.rationale: Stores SHA-256 digests and detects OAuth refresh-token replay via atomic consume(idHash) and bounded consumed-token tombstones to revoke the whole token family without unbounded memory growth.

nodes.label: Threat Model Residual Risks
nodes.rationale: Explicitly documents what the framework leaves to deployments: path-rewrite versioning remaining URI-reachable, process-local stores, fixed-window bursts, password policy, edge WAF, microservice caller auth, and serverless gateway auth.

nodes.label: JWT Key Rotation via kid
nodes.rationale: Refuses unknown kid headers with 401 so removing a key retires all tokens it signed, while keeping default secret required for pre-rotation tokens without kid.

nodes.label: Pure Gateway Envelope Translation
nodes.rationale: Translates API Gateway v1/v2 events and Web Fetch without adding authentication, CORS, timeouts, or graceful shutdown; preserves binary bodies via fatal UTF-8 validation and base64 fallback, and strips bodies on GET/HEAD.

nodes.label: Set-Cookie Gateway Header Separation
nodes.rationale: Separates set-cookie into v2 cookies array or v1 multiValueHeaders['set-cookie'] and removes it from headers because both API Gateway payload versions drop duplicate header names.

nodes.label: wrapPlatformApplication
nodes.rationale: Platform-neutral test wrapper providing handle, get, idempotent close(), and Symbol.asyncDispose for Hono, H3, and Nitro boots.

nodes.label: Idempotent Shared Client Disposal
nodes.rationale: Every store exposes idempotent close() and Symbol.asyncDispose; a shared client is released once unless closeClient: false is stated, and cache writes without a lifetime persist without EX.

nodes.label: Testing Kit Boundary (Non-Runner, Non-Mock, Non-In-Memory)
nodes.rationale: @aponiajs/testing adds no test runner, mocking framework, or synthetic HTTP server; handle() executes the real route table and container with no socket bound.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Log Actors (AponiaFactory, InstanceLoader, RoutesResolver, RouterExplorer, AponiaApplication)
nodes.norm_label: bootstrap log actors (aponiafactory, instanceloader, routesresolver, routerexplorer, aponiaapplication)

nodes.label: LoggerService & Bootstrap Logger Configuration
nodes.rationale: Log levels cascade so log includes warn, error, and fatal; tests pass logger: false to keep output quiet while custom loggers implement log, fatal, error, and warn.

nodes.label: AponiaError & Closed Error Code Union
nodes.rationale: Framework diagnostics throw AponiaError with a code from a closed union and frozen details during graph compilation and route mounting before listen(), so callers assert on error.code instead of message text.

nodes.label: HttpError & httpErrors Problem Details Factories
nodes.rationale: Deliberately thrown application HTTP errors serialize as application/problem+json while keeping server-side cause private, preventing extension overwrites of standard members, and leaving Elysia native 422 validation responses intact.

nodes.label: @aponiajs/testing (createTestApplication)
nodes.rationale: Rewrites the compiled graph in memory for provider overrides so the module class stays untouched and boots share nothing, while leaving test and expect to the test runner.

nodes.label: Bun Spec Lane & Vite+ Conformance Lane

nodes.label: inspectAponiaApplication & AponiaApplicationInspection
nodes.rationale: Compiles the graph without constructing providers or controllers so inspection is side-effect-free, frozen, JSON-serializable, and deterministic; callback-defined routes are omitted because they require executing callbacks.

nodes.label: In-Process Request Testing via application.handle
nodes.rationale: Exercises the real module graph, container, and routes via Request/Response without binding a network port.

nodes.label: @aponiajs/devtools (DevtoolsModule.forRoot)
nodes.rationale: Reports from the neutral boot record with zero platform package imports so the same registration works across Elysia, Hono, H3, and serverless Fetch; mounts nothing when enabled is false.

nodes.label: Boot-Time Configuration Validation & Immutability
nodes.rationale: Declared source replaces process env without implicit merge or per-request reload; schema failures raise INVALID_CONFIGURATION_VALUE.

nodes.label: Health & Readiness Probes (/health/live, /health/ready)
nodes.rationale: On Elysia, health: true mounts unguarded application/health+json probes outside the module graph; readiness flips to 503 on close() before draining while Hono/H3/Nitro leave probes to application routes.

nodes.norm_label: boundary response policies (cors, securityheaders, etag, compression)
nodes.rationale: Run at the request/response boundary on every platform without reading the container; compression is gzip-only and ETag is SHA-1 by deliberate design.

nodes.label: KernelAdapter vs ApplicationAdapter
nodes.rationale: KernelAdapter (Hono, H3) lowers the graph via createPlatformFactory and mounts routes on its router; ApplicationAdapter (Elysia) retains its native executor to preserve native validation, plugins, HandlerContext, and Eden types.

nodes.label: Neutral Plugin Capability Contract (HttpPolicy, RequestLifecycleHook, PlatformCapabilities)
nodes.norm_label: neutral plugin capability contract (httppolicy, requestlifecyclehook, platformcapabilities)
nodes.rationale: Plugins register neutral artifacts without branching on platform names; missing request-path capabilities fail boot atomically with UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM_FEATURE before any route mounts.

nodes.label: Atomic Boot Contract
nodes.rationale: Migrations, config validation, module init, route mounting, gateway registration, and bootstrap finish before opening the port so a half-configured app never serves traffic.

nodes.label: Platform vs Delivery Adapter Distinction
nodes.rationale: Platforms (platform-elysia, platform-hono, platform-h3) boot the module graph and own routing, whereas delivery adapters (serverless, hono, h3, nitro) translate envelopes and forward requests to an already-booted application without a second DI or route table.

nodes.label: @aponiajs/cron

nodes.label: One-Schema @Validation Model Class Pattern

nodes.norm_label: module identity key & one registration per application

nodes.label: Plugin Package Contract (Rules P1-P8)
nodes.rationale: Enforces forRoot/forRootAsync registration, closed AponiaError codes with frozen issues, Nest-shaped layout, runtime neutrality without adapters/, idempotent teardown, and zero mutable module-level state.

nodes.label: createVersionNegotiator

nodes.label: MCP Transport & Origin/Host Gate
nodes.rationale: Builds one SDK server per request and per stdio connection for stateless serving, enforces Origin allowlist and Host/body bounds, supports path: false for stdio-only apps, and closes once via McpRuntimeShutdown.

nodes.label: MCP HTTP Transport Status Guards
nodes.rationale: Refuses foreign Origin (403), oversized body (413), non-JSON content type (415), and non-POST methods (405) before dispatch.

nodes.label: RequestPipeline & Response Policies
nodes.rationale: Compiles CORS preflight, security headers, ETag, and compression into one RequestPipeline shared by handle and listen so native fetch hosts cannot bypass policies.

nodes.label: SDK-Only Protocol Implementation Invariant
nodes.rationale: No JSON-RPC or tool registry lives in @aponiajs/mcp; @modelcontextprotocol/server v2 is the sole wire protocol implementation.

nodes.label: buildOpenApiDocument
nodes.rationale: Walks container controllers to lower compiled route plans into an OpenAPI description (omitting ALL, OPTIONS, HEAD, and WebSocket gateways) without enforcing or validating requests.

nodes.label: OpenApiInfo & OpenApiConfiguration Contract
nodes.rationale: Declares info ({ title, version, description? }) so additive top-level fields fit later without breaking the shape; requires title/version and serves absent description as empty rather than a placeholder.

nodes.label: Inlined Schema Projection & Empty components.schemas
nodes.rationale: Every declared route schema (body, query, params, headers, cookie, response) is inlined into its operation with empty components.schemas; @Deprecated() sets deprecated: true.

nodes.label: Shared WebSocket Gateway Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Speaks Nest surface (@MessageBody, @ConnectedSocket, @WebSocketServer), encodes frames as { event, data } JSON, and emits exception frames without stack or cause.

nodes.label: Sanitized Adapter Errors & Delivery Guarantees
nodes.rationale: Errors carry stable code, transport name, operation, and package name without leaking connection strings, credentials, topics, or payloads; no delivery claim beyond the protocol is made.

nodes.label: toNitroHandler
nodes.rationale: Superseded by @aponiajs/platform-h3 for new applications because Nitro serves an H3 application natively; forwards requests to application.handle and excludes WebSockets.

nodes.label: collectLifecycleCalls
nodes.rationale: Orders lifecycle hooks by module distance (deepest imports and globals first, root last; reversed with reverseModules on shutdown) while excluding request-scoped and transient instances.

nodes.label: AponiaHttpApplication & AponiaApplicationSurfaceConfig
nodes.rationale: Provides the shared Nest application surface across Elysia, Hono, and H3 via mergeApplicationSurfaceOptions; refuses post-init surface mutations with INVALID_CONFIGURATION.

nodes.label: Platform Capability Contract (requirePlatformCapabilities)
nodes.rationale: Feature packages contribute neutral artifacts and state required capabilities; boot refuses missing request-path capabilities with UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM_FEATURE instead of per-platform allowlists.

nodes.label: Nitro Thin Envelope Adapter
nodes.rationale: Translates only the runtime envelope using Nitro defineHandler and @aponiajs/serverless toFetchHandler without duplicating routing, DI, guards, validation, or filters, keeping Nitro as a peer dependency.

nodes.label: docs/public-api.json (Snapshot Contract Version 1)
nodes.rationale: Freezes every published package's barrel value/type exports independently of JSDoc rendering by tools/api-docs.

nodes.label: Artifact Authority Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Orders truth as Source & tests > aponia manifest > docs/public-api.json > package README/llms.txt > docs/ pages; code/doc disagreements must be fixed together rather than masked.

nodes.label: Framework Change Protocol
nodes.rationale: Mandates contracts-first development, one-way package dependencies, stable AponiaError/HttpError contracts, single-schema validation models, compile-once hot paths, boundary immutability, deterministic tests, and synchronized docs.

nodes.label: AI Agent Safety & Trust Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Treats repo files and manifests as untrusted data, prohibits printing secrets or unauthorized destructive/publish actions, and requires threat-model review on trust boundaries.

nodes.label: --no-observe Flag and Documentation Rewriter
nodes.rationale: Removes @aponiajs/devtools registration, dependency, and devtools documentation sections from generated starters.

nodes.label: Starter Devtools Registration Tradeoff
nodes.rationale: Importing DevtoolsModule.forRoot in AppModule places devtools in the module graph and shares the logger, causing aponia build to decline AppModule's descriptor so inspection falls back to the decorated graph.

nodes.label: scope.guard Revocation Proxy
nodes.rationale: Forwards via Reflect.get(target, property, target) and Reflect.apply(method, target, args) so #private fields and WeakMap-backed state work, trading identity preservation and nested guarding and leaving non-configurable non-writable data properties unwrapped due to proxy invariants.

nodes.label: Immutable Typestate State Machine
nodes.rationale: transition() returns a new immutable machine; invalid static chains fail in tsc while dynamic events and unknown hydrated states throw INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

nodes.label: @aponiajs/compiler Agent Guide
nodes.rationale: Provides runtime enforcement of compiler-grade invariants (revocable lifetimes, exclusive mutation views, typestate, linear consumption) with node:async_hooks scoped only to borrow identity and zero HTTP imports.

nodes.label: Runtime Linear Consumption (Owned and once)
nodes.rationale: Because TypeScript lacks linear types, Owned.consume() and once() enforce single consumption at runtime by throwing CONSUMED_STATE on reuse and implementing both dispose symbols.

nodes.label: Scoped Handle Isolation
nodes.rationale: Scoped<T> is non-assignable to T so raw values cannot leak past scope exit; get() checks scope liveness and moveOut() transfers ownership while revoking the handle.

nodes.label: SCHEDULE_TIMER
nodes.rationale: Injectable timer token replaced in tests for deterministic interval and timeout execution.

nodes.label: StaticRouteExecutionContext
nodes.rationale: Compiles one immutable prototype per route and calls fork(context) per request so concurrent requests never share mutable state.

nodes.label: McpExecutionContext
nodes.rationale: Enhancers are explicit (module options, class decorators, method decorators in order) and HTTP globals from AponiaFactory.create are not inherited automatically.

nodes.label: MCP Enhancer Execution Order
nodes.rationale: Every call runs guards -> interceptors before -> pipes (input bound as body) -> method -> interceptors after reversed -> filters on throw, with getType() returning 'mcp'.

nodes.label: Shared Enhancer Run Order Contract
nodes.rationale: Fixes runtime execution order across platforms: middleware -> guards and interceptor before halves -> handler -> interceptor after halves reversed -> filters most-specific-first.

nodes.label: Guard (CanActivate)
nodes.rationale: Compiles into beforeHandle; returning false rejects with 403 Problem Details while throwing routes to exception filters.

nodes.label: ExceptionFilter (@Catch)
nodes.rationale: Compiles into a route-local error array matched by instanceof most-specific-first; first non-null/non-undefined answer wins.

nodes.label: Interceptor (interceptBefore / interceptAfter)
nodes.rationale: Compiles into beforeHandle/afterHandle; interceptBefore cannot short-circuit and returning undefined from interceptAfter leaves the handler result unchanged.

nodes.label: Default 500 Problem Details Mapping (ExceptionsHandler)
nodes.rationale: Unhandled errors return 500 application/problem+json with INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR without sending the thrown value to the client; throwing filters are logged and treated as declining.

nodes.label: Container-Resolved Enhancer Registration
nodes.rationale: Enhancers named in @UseGuards/@UseInterceptors/@UseFilters must appear in a reachable module's providers or boot fails with MISSING_PROVIDER; registerRoutes and buildPlugin callbacks bypass platform enhancers.

nodes.label: Generated Route Invokers (invokers.generated.ts)
nodes.rationale: Emits literal route invokers at build time to eliminate runtime new Function compilation, falling back gracefully on version mismatch or unprovable handlers.

nodes.label: GraphQL Yoga Neutral HttpPolicy Precedence
nodes.rationale: Sets both policy path and Yoga graphqlEndpoint from one validated configuration value and runs before routing so resolvers inject container providers and non-default endpoints never 404.

nodes.label: Generated Module Descriptors (descriptors.generated.ts)
nodes.rationale: Lowers static @Module/@Controller/@Injectable/@WebSocketGateway/@Validation declarations into data descriptors; declines DynamicModule calls (e.g. .forRoot()) whole and falls back to decorator lowering at boot.

nodes.label: CronConfiguration
nodes.rationale: Declares jobs under an object key rather than a bare array so additive configuration fields remain backwards-compatible.

nodes.label: croner Engine
nodes.rationale: Constructed without a process-global name to avoid cross-boot collisions and given a copy of options so croner defaults never leak into job context.

nodes.label: CronJob
nodes.rationale: Declares run as a method rather than a function property so bivariance under strictFunctionTypes accepts narrower typed option transforms.

nodes.label: CronJobContext
nodes.rationale: Frozen context carrying declared options to prevent one tick from mutating subsequent ticks.

nodes.label: CronJobOptions
nodes.rationale: Derived directly from croner's CronOptions so option additions, renames, or removals cannot silently drift.

nodes.label: CronScheduler
nodes.rationale: Per-boot provider rather than module-level state so multiple applications built from one module class own independent handles and close() stops only its own boot's jobs.

nodes.label: @aponiajs/events
nodes.rationale: In-process typed event emitter without retries, persistence, or at-least-once delivery; durable delivery belongs in a queue package.

nodes.label: EVENT_HANDLER_ERROR
nodes.rationale: Aggregates all handler failures into one AponiaError with a frozen failure list without exposing stack traces or causes.

nodes.label: EventEmitter
nodes.rationale: Preserves registration order, passes payloads by reference without cloning or validating, and executes every handler before reporting aggregated failures.

nodes.label: @OnEvent
nodes.rationale: Records metadata only without constructing or subscribing anything; EventEmitter.bind(instance) binds decorated methods.

nodes.label: No HTTP Runtime Import Invariant
nodes.rationale: platform-core must not import elysia, hono, h3, nitro, or Bun server APIs so every HTTP platform shares runtime-neutral primitives over RouteContext.

nodes.label: Toolchain & Peer Compatibility Contract
nodes.rationale: Pins Bun 1.4.5, Elysia 2.0.0-rc.4, TypeBox ^1.4.6, and TypeScript experimentalDecorators/emitDecoratorMetadata because omitting decorator compiler options yields silently empty route plans and 404s.

nodes.label: MigrationRunner & loadMigrations
nodes.rationale: Runs ordered .sql migrations during onModuleInit with SHA-256 drift detection (INVALID_MIGRATION) and application-supplied advisory locks since the package owns no dialect SQL.

nodes.label: Drizzle-First Boundary & Transaction Lifetime Guard
nodes.rationale: Builds no pool and picks no dialect so Drizzle queries stay native, while guarding transaction handles with compiler lifetimes that throw STALE_LIFETIME if escaped.

nodes.label: MemoryMigrationStore
nodes.rationale: Process-local default migration store; real deployments supply a durable store backed by a database migration table.

nodes.label: MigrationLock
nodes.rationale: Application-supplied advisory lock acquired before reading applied migrations and released in finally without owning dialect-specific lock SQL.

nodes.label: MigrationRunner
nodes.rationale: Applies ordered SQL files during onModuleInit, verifies SHA-256 checksums, shares driver transactions when present, and stops at first failure without recording.

nodes.label: BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS
nodes.rationale: Neutral boot record published by the platform so /graph, /routes, and /flow project identical payloads across Elysia, Hono, H3, and Web Fetch.

nodes.label: @aponiajs/cli /aot Dynamic Import
nodes.rationale: Loaded via dynamic import only on the first /aot request and cached process-wide so unused devtools avoids CLI load overhead.

nodes.label: MCP Discovery
nodes.rationale: Discovery is a boot decision: duplicate tool or prompt names, invalid names, or out-of-graph include entries throw before the endpoint serves a request.

nodes.label: McpModule
nodes.rationale: Owns forRoot, forRootAsync, options, and the generated HTTP controller while delegating protocol implementation to @modelcontextprotocol/server v2.

nodes.label: OpenApiModule
nodes.rationale: Exposes synchronous forRoot (and deprecated register) without forRootAsync because configuration validates synchronously and compiled routes are only observable during boot.

nodes.norm_label: mount path typeerror vs configuration aponiaerror
nodes.rationale: Non-absolute mount paths are source-level programming mistakes (TypeError during registration), whereas invalid configuration values throw AponiaError(INVALID_CONFIGURATION_VALUE) with total issue reporting.

nodes.rationale: aponia build declines lowering modules whose imports name an OpenApiModule registration because it is not a @Module() class, though runtime decorator lowering still boots and serves the document.

nodes.label: @Tool Decorator
nodes.rationale: Metadata-only decorator re-exported from @aponiajs/common; tools are dispatched via JSON-RPC on /mcp rather than controller HTTP routes.

nodes.label: resolvePipe & resolveApplicationPipe
nodes.rationale: resolveApplicationPipe propagates MISSING_PROVIDER from the root module while resolvePipe keeps an empty-constructor fallback only for route-level pipes with no declared dependencies.

nodes.label: APP_* Pseudo-Providers
nodes.rationale: Exempt from duplicate-token checks, execute in declaration order, resolve in the declaring module without empty-constructor fallback (raising MISSING_PROVIDER if missing), and disallow direct token lookup.

nodes.label: One OpenApiModule Registration Invariant
nodes.rationale: The module provides and exports the configuration token itself to avoid a module cycle; two registrations with distinct keys cause AMBIGUOUS_PROVIDER on read-back, while shared keys raise DUPLICATE_MODULE.

nodes.rationale: The Vite+ lane runs on Node where Elysia 2 has no listen() adapter, so test/*.conformance.ts exercises handle() without sockets while real-port cases live in the Bun lane.

nodes.label: E4: Always-Async beforeHandle/afterHandle & Double Fork
nodes.rationale: Declaring beforeHandle and afterHandle unconditionally async forces tail=false and Promise allocation on sync guards/interceptors (-27.0% guarded, -47.0% intercepted).

nodes.label: E2: Unconditional Per-Route Default Error Filter
nodes.norm_label: e2: unconditional per-route default error filter
nodes.rationale: Attaching defaultFilter to every route's error hook sets hasErrorHook=true in Elysia, forcing responseMode='set' instead of 'compact'.

nodes.label: E1: Unconditional withRouteMemory Transform Hook
nodes.rationale: Injecting a transform hook onto every decorated route disqualifies Elysia inlineBareRoute and writes to a WeakMap per request even when no observer package reads matchedRouteOf.

nodes.rationale: Compile-at-boot specialization lets bare routes match raw Elysia bound speed (4.60M ops/s) while keeping sync enhancers on Elysia's sync tail lane and avoiding RxJS allocation unless .pipe() is invoked.

nodes.label: Zero-RxJS CallHandler Fast Path
nodes.rationale: Making CallHandler.handle() a PromiseLike thenable avoids Observable and operator-array allocations unless user code calls .pipe().

nodes.label: HandlerContext & definePlugin Type Projection
nodes.rationale: Explicitly links erased PluginModule imports into handler types without ambient declaration merging, which would leak across compilations.

nodes.label: RefreshTokenService
nodes.rationale: Issues and rotates opaque refresh tokens storing only SHA-256 digests; atomic consume detects token reuse, throws INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN, and revokes the token family.

nodes.label: Refresh Store Tombstone Cap
nodes.rationale: Consumed-token tombstones share MemoryRefreshTokenStore's record cap so rotation loops cannot grow memory without bound or degrade store scans.

nodes.label: Live PTTL Rate-Limit Reset
nodes.rationale: RedisRateLimitStore derives resetAt from live PTTL instead of Date.now() + windowMs so RateLimit-Reset and Retry-After headers do not slide forward on every hit.

nodes.label: Single-Trip Lua Refresh Rotation
nodes.rationale: RedisRefreshTokenStore.consume executes read, delete, and family tombstone creation in one Lua round trip so a token replay revokes the entire family.

nodes.label: Exclusion of configureNative on TestApplicationOptions
nodes.rationale: TestApplication erases TNativeApplication to AnyElysia, so TestApplicationOptions omits configureNative rather than accepting a type parameter that the wrapper discards.

nodes.label: Direct Port-0 Binding in listen()
nodes.community_name: Direct Port-0 Binding in listen & TestServer
nodes.rationale: listen() binds port 0 and reads the port from getUrl() instead of reserving and closing an ephemeral port first, preventing race-condition test flakes; used only when WebSocket upgrades need a real socket.

nodes.label: E6: Global onRequest/onAfterResponse Disabling Bun Static Promotion
nodes.norm_label: e6: global onrequest/onafterresponse disabling bun static promotion
nodes.rationale: Registering global onRequest hooks forces eager Context allocation and materializeSetHeaders before route matching and disables Bun.serve native static response promotion.

nodes.label: NestJS Scope.REQUEST Bubbling & Subtree Scoping
nodes.rationale: Scope.REQUEST bubbles up the dependency graph; isolating AsyncLocalStorage and request-scope wrapping to reachable subtrees prevents a 71.2% penalty on singleton routes.

nodes.label: ConfigurableModuleBuilder & moduleOptionsProviders
nodes.rationale: Provides immutable Nest-compatible dynamic module generation and a single shared async lowering (useFactory, useClass, useExisting) so plugin packages never duplicate async-options wiring.

nodes.label: Domain-First Nest-Shaped Source Layout
nodes.rationale: Organizes package source under domain directories with one Nest kind suffix per file and builds from src/ rather than Nest's lib/.

nodes.label: WebSocket Gateway Envelope & Provider-Based Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Uses a documented { event, data } JSON envelope over native WebSockets and resolves gateway singletons through the module container rather than constructing a separate gateway container.

nodes.label: Synchronized Release Channels (release/alpha, release/beta, release/rc, main)
nodes.norm_label: synchronized release channels (release/alpha, release/beta, release/rc, main)
nodes.rationale: Every push raises the synchronized workspace version via bun run version:* so manifests and bun.lock never drift.

nodes.label: Contract-First Page Standard & Automated Docs Guards

nodes.norm_label: contract-first page standard & automated docs guards
nodes.rationale: Maintains single-index reachability, valid internal anchors, accurate package claims, and static site generation via docs:build and scripts/docs-*.spec.ts.

nodes.label: Superseded Delivery Adapters (@aponiajs/h3, @aponiajs/hono, @aponiajs/nitro)
nodes.rationale: Superseded by @aponiajs/platform-h3 and @aponiajs/platform-hono for new applications; retained for mounting when an external runtime owns the server and forwards to application.handle. Nitro support is experimental.

nodes.label: AponiaApplicationOptions.plugins
nodes.rationale: Whole-plugin mount on the root application before module-graph plugins for dynamic call-built plugins that compileRootModule and static descriptor builds cannot lower as module imports.

nodes.label: AponiaFactory.createApplicationContext
nodes.rationale: Boots provider graph without HTTP listener or controller instantiation for worker contexts.

nodes.label: Request-Scoped Controllers and Enhancers
nodes.rationale: Constructed once per request via instance resolver (or per socket for gateways); callbacks, message patterns, and generated invokers refuse request-scoped controllers because they close over one instance.

nodes.label: API Versioning and Fetch-Boundary Negotiation
nodes.rationale: Mounts /vN routes once and rewrites header, media-type, or custom-extracted requests at the fetch boundary to /vN rather than creating duplicate route mounts, answering 400 API_VERSION_NOT_FOUND for undeclared versions.

nodes.label: AponiaJS Deliberate Non-Goals
nodes.rationale: Excludes a Node.js runtime track, class-validator/class-transformer, Socket.IO rooms, Express/Fastify MVC adapters, Prisma/TypeORM adapters, and built-in queue brokers.

nodes.label: Contract Immutability & Authoring Error Discipline
nodes.rationale: Freezes public descriptors, forbids any, uses #private fields, and throws TypeError synchronously on invalid decorator calls while using AponiaError for runtime failures.

nodes.label: Compiled ClassSerializerInterceptor Plan
nodes.rationale: Precompiling @Exclude/@Expose/@Transform metadata into a WeakMap<Constructor, CompiledSerializerPlan> avoids per-request Reflect lookups and Object.entries allocations.

nodes.label: E3: AponiaApplication.handle() Promise Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Wrapping nativeApplication.handle with a .then check and .finally callback even when releaseRequest is undefined reduces bare route throughput by 16.0% (2.36M vs 2.81M ops/s).

nodes.label: C2-C5: Platform-Core/Hono/H3 Eager Context, Interpreted rou3 & Double Response
nodes.norm_label: c2-c5: platform-core/hono/h3 eager context, interpreted rou3 & double response
nodes.rationale: Eager context freezing, per-request guard unrolling, interpreted rou3 findRoute, and double Response construction explain the 4.71x Hono and 4.86x H3 gap vs raw runtimes.

nodes.label: Pipe Resolution and Execution (resolvePipe, resolveApplicationPipe, executePipes)
nodes.norm_label: pipe resolution and execution (resolvepipe, resolveapplicationpipe, executepipes)
nodes.rationale: Route-level pipes resolve without a container; application-level pipes resolve through the root module and fail with MISSING_PROVIDER when unreachable.

nodes.label: StaticRouteExecutionContext
nodes.rationale: Forked per request so concurrent requests never share mutable execution context state.

nodes.label: Global Enhancer Tokens (APP_GUARD, APP_INTERCEPTOR, APP_FILTER, APP_PIPE)
nodes.norm_label: global enhancer tokens (app_guard, app_interceptor, app_filter, app_pipe)

nodes.label: Non-Enumerable Application Seams (Diagnostics, Container, Store)
nodes.rationale: Uses non-enumerable, non-writable symbol properties because Elysia walks instance keys during composition.

nodes.label: Build-Time Module Descriptor Artifact (module-descriptor-artifact.ts)
nodes.rationale: Adopted whole for the module graph when stamped with matching release and root class name (guarded by isModuleDefinition); falls back to decorator lowering otherwise.

nodes.label: HandlerContext, definePlugin, and PluginModule
nodes.rationale: Explicitly passes Elysia plugin types (~Singleton and ~Ephemeral, excluding ~Volatile) into decorated handlers because decorator compilation erases imported plugin types.

nodes.label: createH3Host and H3 Runtime Binding
nodes.rationale: Registers routes via app.on/app.all, mounts module middleware on H3, upgrades WebSocket gateways via crossws/defineWebSocketHandler, and starts Bun.serve on listen.

nodes.label: createHonoHost and Hono Runtime Binding
nodes.rationale: Registers routes via app.on/app.all, mounts module middleware on Hono, upgrades WebSocket gateways via Hono's Bun adapter, and starts Bun.serve on listen.

nodes.label: OutboxService and SqliteOutboxStore
nodes.rationale: Delivers recorded messages in order and stops at the first sink rejection (keeping it at front) so the next flush retries in order.

nodes.label: Processor Surface (@Processor, WorkerHost, @InjectQueue, JOB_REF, ProcessorExplorer)
nodes.rationale: Maps BullMQ-shaped processor names (AponiaQueue_<name>) onto in-process QueueService handlers without broker worker subscriptions or lock renewals.

nodes.label: QueueModule (forRoot / forRootAsync)
nodes.rationale: ConfigurableModuleBuilder registration validating queue bounds, outbox bounds, and store shapes upfront with total INVALID_QUEUE_OPTIONS issue lists.

nodes.label: RateLimitStore and MemoryRateLimitStore
nodes.rationale: Requires positive integer maxKeys and evicts oldest insertion to avoid unbounded maps; clock is injectable for deterministic tests.

nodes.label: RateLimitGuard and @RateLimit()
nodes.rationale: Sets RateLimit-* headers before deciding and adds Retry-After on refusal, returning 429 Problem Details rather than 403.

nodes.label: RateLimitModule (forRoot / forRootAsync)
nodes.rationale: ConfigurableModuleBuilder registration with RATE_LIMIT_MODULE_OPTIONS and isGlobal extra; reports invalid configuration as AponiaError INVALID_RATE_LIMIT with frozen issue list.

nodes.label: RateLimitService
nodes.rationale: Increments request bucket exactly once per request; guard never retries or double-increments on refusal.

nodes.label: Fixed Request Lifecycle Run Order
nodes.rationale: Fixed run order: middleware, guards and interceptor before halves, handler, interceptor after halves reversed, filters most-specific-first.

nodes.label: Elysia Bootstrap Order
nodes.rationale: Load-bearing sequence ensures plugins, providers, controllers, onModuleInit, async plugin composition, WebSocket gateways, and onApplicationBootstrap run in deterministic dependency order before listening.

nodes.label: Default Problem Details Exception Mapping and reportThroughLogger
nodes.norm_label: default problem details exception mapping and reportthroughlogger
nodes.rationale: Compiled last into each route's local error array rather than on the root Elysia app because Elysia root hooks outrank route filters; declines Elysia native responses and guards failure logging via reportThroughLogger.

nodes.label: Per-Request ExecutionContext Fork
nodes.rationale: Compiles one immutable route prototype and calls fork(context) per hook invocation so overlapping async requests cannot overwrite shared context.

nodes.label: H3 Platform Independence and Shared Surface
nodes.norm_label: h3 platform independence and shared surface
nodes.rationale: Depends only on common, core, and platform-core (never another platform) with h3 as peer dependency; delegates validation, enhancers, lifecycle, and version negotiation to platform-core.

nodes.label: Hono Platform Independence and Shared Surface
nodes.norm_label: hono platform independence and shared surface
nodes.rationale: Depends only on common, core, and platform-core (never another platform) with hono as peer dependency; delegates validation, enhancers, lifecycle, and version negotiation to platform-core.

nodes.label: Durable Backlog vs Distributed Broker Boundary
nodes.norm_label: durable backlog vs distributed broker boundary
nodes.rationale: Supplied QueueStore persists job backlog across restarts (hydrating running jobs as pending and flushing tracked writes) for one consumer, rather than acting as a cross-process claiming broker.

nodes.label: Deterministic Retry, Timeout, Idempotency, and Bounded Dead-Letter Policy
nodes.norm_label: deterministic retry, timeout, idempotency, and bounded dead-letter policy
nodes.rationale: Uses injectable clock/timer for deterministic backoffMs * 2^(attempts - 1), cooperative AbortController timeouts (QUEUE_JOB_TIMEOUT), bounded maxDeadLetters eviction, and runOutsideAsyncContexts isolation.

nodes.label: Queue Shutdown Sequence (drain -> close -> flush)
nodes.rationale: onModuleDestroy drains due jobs first, then aborts in-flight work via close(), and finally flushes tracked store writes.

nodes.label: Default Route-Identity Rate Limit Key
nodes.rationale: Defaults to route identity rather than client-supplied headers (X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP) so trusted proxy extraction is an explicit application key-function decision.
